step_balanced_graph.weighting: inverse labelled row count per training time step, normalized to mean one

selection: Select the fixed 75% V2 + 25% candidate blend with the highest mean development AUC gain among those with minimum gain >= -0.0005 and positive mean. Require confirmation mean gain > 0 and neither confirmation gain < -0.001. Otherwise retain V2. No blend-weight search.
rationale: Reproduce the previously reported V16 equal-step weighting improvement under expanded validation before considering its first public submission.
